test_title: PYST 77: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CLERK' is written as 'BKEQJ' and 'OFFICE' is written as 'OEEIBE'. How will 'POST' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] The logic followed here is: **Consonants - 1; Vowels are the same.** 'CLERK' is written as 'BKEQJ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d306979547059ab624e7f9596331df0a3341413f7b4ce7493423bf7a986a5e4f.png]
